# KRAIL Journal

Stories from the Sydney commute. Things to do, places to eat, app stories
and behind the scenes, written for people who actually catch the train.

KRAIL is a Sydney public transport app. It is not affiliated with or
endorsed by Transport for New South Wales.

## Posts

- [Rather take the ferry? Filter your Sydney trip](https://krail.app/blog/choose-sydney-transport-mode/): The Mode button in KRAIL switches off the kinds of travel you do not want, so your Sydney results only show trips on train, bus, ferry or metro. (App showcase, 17 September 2026)
- [Know the route number? Find your Sydney bus stop](https://krail.app/blog/find-sydney-bus-stop-by-number/): Type a bus route number into KRAIL and you get every Sydney stop that bus goes past, in order, so you pick yours without knowing its official name. (App showcase, 17 September 2026)
- [Find any Sydney bus or train stop on the map](https://krail.app/blog/find-sydney-stop-on-map/): In KRAIL you can find a Sydney bus, train or ferry stop by tapping it on a map, see what is leaving from it, and choose it for your trip without typing. (App showcase, 17 September 2026)
- [Six colours and dark mode for your Sydney commute](https://krail.app/blog/krail-colours-dark-mode-sydney/): KRAIL comes in six colours, each with its own little tagline, plus light and dark mode, so your Sydney commute app reads right at 6am and at 6pm. (App showcase, 17 September 2026)
- [Is it late or gone? Live Sydney train and bus times](https://krail.app/blog/live-sydney-train-bus-ferry-times/): KRAIL shows a live countdown, the platform or wharf, and crosses out the old time when a Sydney train, bus or ferry runs late. Every mode, not just trains. (App showcase, 17 September 2026)
- [Need to be there by 9? Plan the Sydney trip ahead](https://krail.app/blog/plan-sydney-trip-leave-or-arrive/): KRAIL plans a Sydney train, bus or ferry trip for later, either leaving at a set time or arriving by one, for today or any day up to a week ahead. (App showcase, 17 September 2026)
- [Save your Sydney commute, open it in one tap](https://krail.app/blog/save-sydney-commute-one-tap/): Tap the star on any trip in KRAIL and it lives on your home screen, so tomorrow morning your Sydney commute is one tap away instead of two searches. (App showcase, 17 September 2026)
- [See your whole Sydney trip drawn on a map](https://krail.app/blog/see-sydney-trip-on-map/): Tap Maps on any trip in KRAIL and you see where every Sydney train, bus or ferry goes, where you walk, and where you change, in each line's own colours. (App showcase, 17 September 2026)
- [Check Sydney Park & Ride spaces before you leave](https://krail.app/blog/sydney-park-and-ride-live-spaces/): KRAIL puts live Park & Ride spaces for Sydney stations on the home screen, so you know there is a spot before you back out of the driveway. (App showcase, 17 September 2026)
- [Live departure board for any Sydney stop](https://krail.app/blog/sydney-stop-departure-board/): KRAIL has a live departure board for any Sydney stop, with countdowns, platforms and a line filter, so you see everything leaving from where you stand. (App showcase, 17 September 2026)
- [Beat the Tallawong Park & Ride parking lottery](https://krail.app/blog/tallawong-parking-lottery/): Everyone says the Tallawong car park fills. Almost nobody knows there are three of them, and they do not fill at the same rate. (Things to do, 23 August 2026)
- [Auburn Cherry Blossom Festival by train and shuttle](https://krail.app/blog/auburn-cherry-blossom-festival-without-a-car/): Every ticket is booked online, there is no buying one at the gate. Here is the Sydney train and free shuttle that gets you to Auburn instead. (Things to do, 14 August 2026)
